change-after-cutoff-log.name: Change After Cutoff Log
change-after-cutoff-log.description: List revisions from the change-log sheet against each event's cutoff from the order.

count-vs-guarantee.name: Count Versus Guarantee
count-vs-guarantee.description: List expected, guaranteed, and any actual they recorded, plus vegetarian, kids, and vendor-meal splits as their sheet adds them.

dietary-list.name: Dietary List
dietary-list.description: Build a per-event dietary list from their dietary sheet, the event order, and the allergen file.

equipment-vs-events.name: Equipment Versus Events
equipment-vs-events.description: Compare house equipment on-hand to the same-day event pack-outs: chafers, cambros, urns, china.

leftover-form-completeness.name: Leftover Form Completeness
leftover-form-completeness.description: For events whose leftover policy requires a signed release, list form present or missing from the leftover-form folder against the event-order list.

pack-out-list.name: Pack-Out List
pack-out-list.description: Build a pack-out from the event order, house equipment list, and their pack-out sheet.

rental-pos.name: Rental POs
rental-pos.description: List open rental POs against events: item, qty, deliver window, return window.

staffing-from-file.name: Staffing From File
staffing-from-file.description: Build a staffing board from the roster and the event-order labor grid.

week-of-events.name: Week-Of Events
week-of-events.description: Build a week board from their event-order export and calendar.
